title: Expected input contract: sealed E2a Pareto data
description: What this protocol requires from E2a's persisted output before it may execute. Derived entirely from E2's own frozen source (src/muru/v2_calibration/e2_search.py FrontRow/SeedFrontResult, e2_worlds.py WorldContent/WorldTruth, e2_scoring.py ScoredRow) -- never from E2a's own result files, which this design was written without reading.
provenance_note: This contract was authored by reading only e2_search.py, e2_worlds.py, e2_classify.py, e2_scoring.py, e2_aggregate.py, rc5_selection.py, g2_contract.py, identity_contract.py, and discovery/equivalence.py -- all frozen source, zero outcome content. No file under results/e2/ was opened while authoring this document.

admissibility_requirement.rule: every row consumed by this protocol MUST carry admissibility == DECISION_ADMISSIBLE. E2b rows (Held-out replay) carry DECISION_INADMISSIBLE and MUST be filtered out or absent from the input file entirely before this protocol's implementation is authorized to run. A static check must assert this filter ran, not merely that it exists in code.

preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.name: retention_identity_regression
preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.requirement: the instrumented engine's argmax(score)-retained candidate must be byte-identical to the frozen production path's, for every seed in the control set, before any E2a record is used for anything -- including this protocol

preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.name: world_count_reconciliation
preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.requirement: exactly 540 world_id values present, each unique, bijective with world_ordinal in [0, 540) via the formula in world_identity_and_namespace below

preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.name: seed_count_reconciliation
preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.requirement: exactly 30 seed records (seed_ordinal_k in [0, 30)) present per world_id, no duplicates, no gaps

preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.name: namespace_disjointness
preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.requirement: every world's seed payload is prefixed 'muru-v2-calibration|', never 'paper-benchmark-v1|'; verified by e2_worlds.assert_seed_namespace_disjoint, not by inspection

preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.name: R0_replay_self_consistency
preflight_requirements_before_consumptio.requirement: this protocol's own R0 (argmax(score)) re-scoring of the input, run through the identical rc5_selection.group_and_select grouping, must reproduce E2a's own sealed first_loss_stage, selection_count, and representative fields exactly, for all 540 worlds, before any non-control policy (R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6) result is reported

truth.support.note: frozenset of GRAMMAR_PRIMITIVES names; used as classify_support's truth_support operand

truth.law_string.note: used only for the truth_equivalent (C/D split) check via discovery.equivalence.algebraically_equivalent; never read by any within-seed retention or search-time function

argmax_score_label_position.note: position within rows of the row R0 would retain; must correspond to exactly one row with retained_by_argmax_score == true

engine_complexity.note: this protocol's candidate_set_size / complexity_burden metrics and R4's/R5's/R6's rules all key off this field

expression_string.note: as-emitted, PySR x{i} naming; must be parseable via g2_contract._safe_parse / rc5_selection.parse_production_candidate

valid_r2.note: load-bearing for R1, R2's vote reduction, R4, R5, R6

loss.note: must be finite for every row; a non-finite loss anywhere in a seed's rows is an EXECUTION_FAILURE per rc5_selection.select_row_label, not a silently droppable row

score.note: load-bearing for R0 (control) and R2's within-seed ranking

template_key_repr.note: used for R6's cross-seed recurrence check; must be computed by identity_contract.template_key_string, not re-derived

retained_by_argmax_score.note: exactly one true per seed's rows when status == COMPLETED_WITH_FRONT

required_per_scored_row_fields.note: the truth-joined pass, computed downstream of the search and never consumed by any retention-stage function in this protocol -- only by the C/D/E stage classification

truth_equivalent.note: the C/D split's own discriminator; null means undetermined (SIMPLIFY_TIMEOUT or excessive op count) and such cases must be flagged, not silently folded into C

cross_reference_requirement.rule: every FrontRow within a SeedFrontResult must have exactly one corresponding ScoredRow, in the same order, joined only by (world_id, seed, expression_string) -- the join e2_aggregate.evaluate_world already performs via zip(sr.rows, scored_by_seed[sr.seed]). This protocol's implementation must assert len(rows) == len(scored_rows) per seed before using either, exactly as e2_aggregate.py's own assertion does.

what_this_protocol_never_reads: any E2b (Held-out replay) row where admissibility != DECISION_ADMISSIBLE
any Held-out or Challenge partition case identifier or content
any peer-session summary, Pareto front visualization, or conclusion document

digest_and_seal_requirement.rule: before this protocol's implementation consumes any E2a record, it must verify a manifest digest (per MURU_V2_RETENTION_REMEDIATION_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE.json's e2a_source block) matching the digest recorded at the moment E2a's own results/e2/manifest.json was sealed. A mismatch means E2a's output changed after sealing and this protocol must refuse to run, exactly as governance.py's Held-out refusal gate refuses on an incomplete or tampered lock.
